name: Say That You Love Me
source:
You wake up to find that you've been kidnapped by your knight?! And he claims he loves you?! What are you going to do?

[From [url=https://writer31.itch.io/say-that-you-love-me]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你一觉醒来，竟发现自己被贴身骑士给绑架了？！而且他还口口声声说深爱着你？！接下来你该怎么办才好？

[摘自[url=https://writer31.itch.io/say-that-you-love-me]itch.io[/url]]
